# 🛠️ Deployment & Synchronization Tooling

This directory contains automation scripts that compile vendor-agnostic assets in `global/` and `templates/` into platform-specific configuration directories.

---

## 📄 Core Scripts

* **`sync_configs.py`**: Cross-platform Python deployment engine, zero external dependencies (stdlib only).
  * Combines markdown instructions into `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
  * Combines the same markdown instructions into `CLAUDE.md` at the repo root for Claude Code / Claude Agent SDK. Both are stamped with a `<!-- Generated by ai-governance-starter-kit vX.Y.Z ... -->` header from the root `VERSION` file.
  * Copies prompts to `.vscode/prompts/`.
  * Copies agent roles to `.copilot/agents/`.
  * Copies skill folders to `.claude/skills/<name>/` for Claude Code's native Skills system.
  * Formats and outputs global MCP server configs to `.vscode/mcp.json` and `.copilot/mcp.json`.
  * Seeds a `LEARNINGS.md` mistakes/gotchas log at the target repo root — only if one doesn't already exist, so accumulated entries are never overwritten by a re-sync.
  * Reads/writes `.ai-governance.json` at the output root: which domain templates are active, which individual files are excluded per category, and which project-local folders are merged in as "bring your own" additions. See the main `README.md`'s "Include/Exclude & Bring Your Own" section for the schema and workflow.

---

## 🚀 Execution Options

```bash
# 1. Interactive Menu Mode (Recommended for developers, first run)
python tooling/sync_configs.py

# 2. Automated / Headless CLI Mode (Recommended for CI/CD)
python tooling/sync_configs.py --templates Cloud DevOps --output /path/to/target-repo

# 3. Re-sync using a previously saved .ai-governance.json selection (no flags needed)
python tooling/sync_configs.py --output /path/to/target-repo

# 4. Discard a saved selection and re-run interactive template selection from scratch
python tooling/sync_configs.py --reconfigure --output /path/to/target-repo
```

Passing `--templates` explicitly always overrides a saved selection (useful for CI, where you want the template list pinned in the pipeline config rather than read from a file). Omitting it re-runs the interactive menu on a first sync, or silently reuses `.ai-governance.json` on every sync after that.
